entries.title: Ezekiel 42:1
segments: ¶Then he brought me out into the outer court, by the way toward the north; and he brought me into the chamber which [was] opposite the separating courtyard, and which [was] opposite the building toward the north.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:2
segments: Facing the length, [which was] one hundred cubits (the width was fifty cubits), was the north door.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:3
segments: Opposite the inner court of twenty [cubits], and opposite the pavement of the outer court, [was] gallery against gallery in three [stories].

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:4
segments: In front of the chambers, toward the inside, [was] a walk ten cubits wide, at a distance of one cubit; and their doors faced north.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:5
segments: Now the upper chambers [were] shorter, because the galleries took away [space] from them more than from the lower and middle stories of the building.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:6
segments: For they [were] in three [stories] and did not have pillars like the pillars of the courts; therefore [the upper level] was shortened more than the lower and middle levels from the ground up.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:7
segments: And a wall which [was] outside ran parallel to the chambers, at the front of the chambers, toward the outer court; its length [was] fifty cubits.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:8
segments: The length of the chambers toward the outer court [was] fifty cubits, whereas that facing the temple [was] one hundred cubits.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:9
segments: At the lower chambers [was] the entrance on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:10
segments: Also [there were] chambers in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, opposite the separating courtyard and opposite the building.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:11
segments: [There was] a walk in front of them also, and their appearance [was] like the chambers which [were] toward the north; they [were] as long and as wide as the others, and all their exits and entrances [were] according to plan.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:12
segments: And corresponding to the doors of the chambers that [were] facing south, as one enters them, [there was] a door in front of the walk, the way directly in front of the wall toward the east.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:13
segments: Then he said to me, "The north chambers [and] the south chambers, which [are] opposite the separating courtyard, [are] the holy chambers where the priests who approach the LORD shall eat the most holy offerings. There they shall lay the most holy offerings-the grain offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering-for the place [is] holy.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:14
segments: "When the priests enter them, they shall not go out of the holy [chamber] into the outer court; but there they shall leave their garments in which they minister, for they [are]  holy. They shall put on other garments; then they may approach [that] which [is] for the people."

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:15
segments: ¶Now when he had finished measuring the inner temple, he brought me out through the gateway that faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:16
segments: He measured the east side with the measuring rod, five hundred rods by the measuring rod all around.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:17
segments: He measured the north side, five hundred rods by the measuring rod all around.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:18
segments: He measured the south side, five hundred rods by the measuring rod.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:19
segments: He came around to the west side [and] measured five hundred rods by the measuring rod.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:20
segments: He measured it on the four sides; it had a wall all around, five hundred [cubits] long and five hundred wide, to separate the holy areas from the common.
